- [RCTS.1.2.13] **`libraries`** (optional) — an object mapping a library's
  dotted name to its DS source. A harness must make each entry the module
  that [LIMP.3.1.4] resolves its name to. The program's imports resolve
  against these modules, then against the standard library ([RCTS.1.2.14]),
  and against nothing else, as a compiler's search path holds the bundle
  after every entry an invocation names ([LIMP.3.3.1]).
